description: Build Swap. Calls only POST /v4/trading/swap and returns an unsigned transaction for the user to sign. This tool does not sign, submit, or broadcast, and it does not accept a private key. Solana API endpoint for building token swaps. Build and return unsigned transactions for direct swaps on DEXs like Pump.fun, Raydium and more.

body.description: Request payload model for swap proxy params parameters used by this API endpoint.

accountAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

closeInputAta.description: When true, append closeAccount on input SPL ATA after a full-balance sell.

closeWsolAta.description: Ephemeral WSOL path on sell: create WSOL ATA, sync native, then close.

createOutputAta.description: Create output SPL ATA idempotently before swap (buy when wallet has no output ATA).

enrich.description: When true, ix-builder attaches print-ready enrichment (simulation, fees, USD, retention %) on POST /v4/trading/swap responses. Forwarded verbatim to ix-builder; ignored by aggregators.

enumerateRoutes.description: Build multiple route candidates (up to 10). Default on; set false to stop at first success.

gasless.description: Use Vybe fee payer for gas

inputBalanceExact.description: Exact input balance from wallet token-balance (UI units); used with closeInputAta.

inputDecimals.description: Input token decimals when paired with inputBalanceExact (optional; on-chain fetch otherwise).

inputMintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

inputMintDecimals.description: Input mint decimals from client cache.

inputMintPrice.description: Client USD price for the input mint (skips backend price fetch when set).

liquidity.description: Known USD pool liquidity from market discovery; forwarded to ix-builder as a hint for pinned swaps and route enrichment. Accepts legacy `marketScore` as an alias.

marketFetchMode.description: Market discovery mode for Vybe router: "full" | "trades" | "rpc".

outputMintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

outputMintDecimals.description: Output mint decimals from client cache.

outputMintPrice.description: Client USD price for the output mint (skips backend price fetch when set).

poolAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

postSwapNeeded.description: Caller indicates a post-swap bridge leg is required after the main swap.

preSwapNeeded.description: Caller indicates a pre-swap bridge leg is required before the main swap.

programAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

protocol.description: Enumeration of supported swap proxy protocol values used by this API model.

router.description: Enumeration of supported swap proxy router values used by this API model.

solPrice.description: Client USD SOL price when neither leg is SOL/WSOL (fee/rent USD).

name: build-swap
title: Build Swap
